name: Speed Keys
description: Speed up or slow down any video from the keyboard.

gallery.author: OyNIx
gallery.about: Press ] to speed up the video you're watching by a quarter, [ to slow it down, and \ to go back to normal speed. A small label shows the new speed for a second. It works on any site that uses the standard video element, which is nearly all of them, and stays out of the way while you're typing in a text field.
